text:
lena_peopleops: Heads up — we have an expedited offer for a Sr ML SWE (Jules) in Berlin. Hiring manager wants start 4/15. Comp band needs +10% exception; finance signoff needed. Details below.
marcos_recruiter: Candidate confirmed availability and is open to a quick turnaround. Can we get band exception routed today? They have a competing counteroffer.
jia_hiringmgr: Yes please — critical for the Q2 roadmap. We need the hire in by mid-April. Requesting band 6 -> 6A (+10%).
lena_peopleops: Offer summary: ```base: €160,000
sign-on: €15,000
band: 6 -> requested: 6A (+10%)
start_date: 2026-04-15 (candidate prefers earlier 2026-04-08 if possible)```
oliver_dirfinance: @lena_peopleops tagging finance — need total comp justification, org impact, and a contingency plan. Please include why this is above band.
lena_peopleops: Rationale: candidate is IC4 with MLOps specialization, replaces two roles we consolidated; delay costs ~€30k/month on project timeline. Impact: enables feature delivery in Q2 and avoids partner SLA risk. Candidate CV: internal link (shared in DM).
hr-bot: Routing approval to Finance + People Ops leads. Approver list: oliver_dirfinance, cfo_steph (cc). Expected SLA: 48h. Reply with APPROVE / REJECT / REQUEST_CHANGES.
oliver_dirfinance: I can approve if hiring manager commits to a 6-month performance checkpoint and sign-on lowered to €10,000. @marcos_recruiter can you confirm candidate flexibility? Also need headcount confirmation from product.
marcos_recruiter: Checking now with candidate. Quick note — candidate prefers earlier start 4/08 if we can speed paperwork.
jia_hiringmgr: 4/08 would be ideal. We'll prioritize onboarding (laptop + access + payroll locale). Ops: please prep expedited onboarding checklist.
lena_peopleops: I'll draft the approval memo for exec signoff and set onboarding ops meeting for 2026-04-02. For payroll, candidate is EU-based — will need local payroll setup docs (no W-2; provide passport + bank details).
oliver_dirfinance: Approve band exception contingent on sign-on reduction to €10k and documented 6-month checkpoint. oliver_dirfinance — APPROVED (conditional). :white_check_mark:
marcos_recruiter: Candidate accepts the conditional terms. Sending updated offer now and scheduling 4/08 start if background checks clear. :tada:
